subject: DI02000171

body.en:
Understand the idea

Every parallel branch shares the same supply voltage;its current is determined by its own impedance.

Explanation and application

  • AnR||L,Cparallel or R||L||Cmodel uses separate ideal branches.Apractical r–Lcoil in parallel with Cis a different topology and has a different resonance formula.
  • Choose Vas reference.For each branch Ik=V/Zk.Then apply KCLas phasors:I=ΣIk.Never add current magnitudes unless the currents are in phase.
  • For ideal branches IR=V/R,IL=−jV/XLand IC=+jV/XC.Total I=V/R+j(V/XC−V/XL).
  • Areal coil contributes both in-phase and reactive current.Resolve its actual lag angle rather than forcing every coil current to−90°.
What adds directly in parallel?

Complex admittances or branch-current phasors,not current magnitudes.

  • Vનેreferenceલો.દરેકbranchમાટેIk=V/ZkઅનેKCLથીI=ΣIkphasorરૂપેલો.Currentsinphaseનહોયતોmagnitudesનઉમેરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Admittance Y=1/Zhas unit siemens;Y=G+jBseparates its in-phase and quadrature parts.

Explanation and application

  • For Z=R+jX,Y=(R−jX)/(R²+X²).Thus G=R/(R²+X²)and B=−X/(R²+X²);Gis not generally1/Rand Bis not generally1/X.
  • For a pure resistor G=1/R;for pure L,B=−1/(ωL);for pure C,B=ωC.Susceptance is positive capacitive and negative inductive under this convention.
  • Admittance triangle:horizontal G,vertical signed B,hypotenuse |Y|=√(G²+B²),angle θY=atan2(B,G).Ileads Vwhen θY>0and lags when θY<0.
  • φ=angleZ=−angleY.Power uses P=V²Gand Q=−V²B,so the admittance and power-triangle vertical signs are opposite.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Z=R+jXમાટેY=(R−jX)/(R²+X²)છે.G=R/(R²+X²),B=−X/(R²+X²)છે.Gસામાન્યરીતે1/RતથાB1/Xનથી.
  • PureRમાંG=1/R;pureLમાંB=−1/(ωL);pureCમાંB=ωCછે.આconventionમાંcapacitiveBpositive/inductiveBnegativeછે.
  • AdmittancetriangleમાંhorizontalG,verticalsignedB,|Y|=√(G²+B²)તથાθY=atan2(B,G)છે.θY>0માંI,VનેleadઅનેθY<0માંlagકરે.
  • φ=angleZ=−angleYછે.P=V²GતથાQ=−V²Bહોવાથીadmittance/powertriangleનાverticalsignsઊલટાછે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Parallel admittances add directly because the branch voltage is common.

Explanation and application

  • Convert each branch impedance to Yk,then sum real Gparts and signed Bparts:Ytotal=ΣGk+jΣBk.
  • Compute I=VYtotal,|I|=V|Ytotal|,Zeq=1/Ytotaland pf=Gtotal/|Ytotal|for a passive sinusoidal network.Give lead/lag from the sign of B.
  • Compute P=V²Gtotal,Q=−V²Btotaland verify |S|=V|I|=√(P²+Q²).This separately checks the current and power calculations.
  • For a passive model,Gcannot be negative.If Gtotal=Btotal=0,the ideal input is an open circuit with zero current;pfis undefined rather than automatically1.

વિચાર સમજીએ

Branchvoltagecommonહોવાથીparalleladmittancesસીધાંઉમેરાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • દરેકbranchZથીYકરો.પછીrealG/signedBઅલગઉમેરો:Ytotal=ΣGk+jΣBk.
  • I=VYtotal,|I|=V|Ytotal|,Zeq=1/Ytotalઅનેpassivesinusoidalnetworkમાંpf=Gtotal/|Ytotal|લો.Bનાસignથીlead/lagઆપો.
  • P=V²Gtotal,Q=−V²Btotalલો.|S|=V|I|=√(P²+Q²)થીcurrent/powerગણતરીઅલગથીચકાસો.

Understand the idea

Complex algebra solves each actual branch without assuming a pure reactance or a90°branch angle.

Explanation and application

  • For two branches,Zeq=Z1Z2/(Z1+Z2),provided the denominator is nonzero.The safer general route for many branches is Zeq=1/(Σ1/Zk).
  • Divide using conjugates or validated complex arithmetic,then add branch currents in rectangular form.Only after summation calculate magnitude/angle.
  • Verify that V/ZeqequalsΣV/Zkand that total complex power equals the sum of branch complex powers.Different methods must agree on sign as well as magnitude.

વિચાર સમજીએ

  • બેbranchesમાંdenominatornonzeroહોયત્યારેZeq=Z1Z2/(Z1+Z2)છે.અનેકbranchesમાટેZeq=1/(Σ1/Zk)વધુgeneralછે.
  • Conjugateકેvalidatedcomplexarithmeticથીdivideકરો.પછીbranchcurrentsrectangularમાંઉમેરો.Sumપછીજmagnitude/angleગણો.
  • V/Zeq=ΣV/Zkતથાtotalcomplexpower=branchpowersનોsumચકાસો.બંનેmethodsમાંsign/magnitudeબંનેmatchથવાજોઈએ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Parallel resonance is commonly defined by zero net input susceptance,so supply voltage and current are in phase when nonzero conductance is present.

Explanation and application

  • For separate ideal R,L,Cbranches:Y=1/R+j(ωC−1/(ωL)).B=0gives f₀=1/(2π√LC),Z=Rand I=V/R.
  • With constant parallel R,the input impedance is maximum and supply current minimum at f₀.Inductive and capacitive branch currents cancel as phasors but need not be small.
  • For practical coil(r+jωL)in parallel with C,Y=r/(r²+ω²L²)+j[ωC−ωL/(r²+ω²L²)].This is not the same as an ideal Lbranch with an external parallel R.
  • Setting B=0gives ωr²=1/(LC)−r²/L²and fr=(1/2π)√[1/(LC)−r²/L²].Apositive real resonance needs L>Cr²;at it Zr=L/(Cr).
  • For small coil loss,fr≈f₀.In the lossy-coil topology,Gchanges with frequency,so zero-phase resonance and the exact maximum-|Z|frequency need not coincide;the usual peak statement is an ideal/high-Qapproximation.

વિચાર સમજીએ

Parallelresonanceસામાન્યરીતેinputBzeroથીdefineથાય.NonzeroGહોયત્યારેsupplyvoltage/currentinphaseથાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • અલગidealR,L,CbranchesમાંY=1/R+j(ωC−1/(ωL))છે.B=0થીf₀=1/(2π√LC),Z=RઅનેI=V/Rમળે.
  • ConstantparallelRમાંf₀પરinputZmaximum/supplyIminimumછે.L/Cbranchcurrentsphasorરૂપેcancelથાય,પણમોટાહોઈશકે.
  • Practicalcoil(r+jωL)સાથેCparallelહોયત્યારેY=r/(r²+ω²L²)+j[ωC−ωL/(r²+ω²L²)]છે.આexternalparallelRસાથેidealLજેવુંનથી.
  • B=0થીωr²=1/(LC)−r²/L²અનેfr=(1/2π)√[1/(LC)−r²/L²]મળે.PositiverealresonanceમાટેL>Cr²જોઈએ;ત્યારેZr=L/(Cr)છે.
  • Coil lossનાનોહોયતોfr≈f₀છે.LossycoilમાંGfrequencyસાથેબદલે;zero-phaseresonance/exactmaximum-|Z|frequencyસમાનહોયજએવુંનથી.Peakstatementideal/high-Qapproximationછે.

body.en:
Aim and instruments

Measure branch/supply currents and signed power for the actual parallel network.

Instrument selection

  • Use the approved circuit-specific instruments:generator/CROfor waveform work;isolated source,rated load and appropriate ACV/I/real-power instruments for power circuits.Check manual,ranges,leads and component ratings.
  • The source lists mains-rated variacs/banks;these are supervised laboratory resources,not student DIYinstructions.Avariac does not provide isolation.

Connections and model

Place every declared branch across the same approved supply;measure branch currents in their own paths and the supply current before the split.Voltage input spans the supply/load rails.

Procedure

  1. Record the actual branch topology and coil/capacitor losses;with power OFFverify that a parallel element was not mistakenly placed in series.
  2. Under instructor control,record V,f,total I,branch currents and real power.Phasor angles require approved phase/power measurement,not magnitude-only guesswork.
  3. Solve each Zk/Yk,add complex currents,then compare magnitude and pf=P/(VI).Verify Ptotal≈sum of actual branch powers within uncertainty.
  4. Keep actual readings,supply condition,instrument ranges and uncertainty separate from the computed expected reference.
  5. On a discrepancy,stop and check de-energised connections,model assumptions and instrument suitability;do not increase voltage to force agreement.
  6. After approved shutdown,verify safe capacitor discharge and leave the trainer in its required state.Report only work genuinely performed.

Expected calculations and interpretation

Only ideal L/Cbranch currents are exactly±90°.Actual r–Lcoil contributes real current;source current can be smaller than either reactive branch current.

Safe fault finding

If scalar branch-current totals disagree with supply current,first check phasor cancellation rather than assuming a faulty ammeter.Beware current-input short circuits.

Essential precautions

  • Only qualified-supervised energised power-lab work is intended.Never defeat protective earth,connect ammeters across the supply,short phases or change wiring while energised.
  • Scope grounds may be common and earth-referenced.Use approved differential/isolated measurement equipment where needed;never float a mains scope by removing its earth.

Only ideal L/Cbranch currents are exactly±90°.Actual r–Lcoil contributes real current;source current can be smaller than either reactive branch current.
